current_interpretation: Nonempty DMR_COMMENT_TEXT on permit limit rows is not converted into monitoring or comparison rules. The permit_limit_comment_text requirement marks only the empty string as known, leaving 69 nonempty comments uninterpreted. The draft additionally emits explicit unresolved items when comment text matches source-native phrases: 17 rows with 'WHEN DISCHARGING' become conditional_discharge_dependent_monitoring; 40 rows with 'GEOMETRIC MEAN' become aggregated_reporting_requirement; 12 rows with pass/fail phrasing become pass_fail_reporting_semantics. These are named gaps, not resolved meanings.
why_it_matters: Purpose B must decide whether monitoring was required for each FY2025 obligation, including discharge-conditioned requirements. Purpose A and C are affected when comments change how limits apply or how non-numeric results should be read. Without interpreting comments, discharge-dependent limits and special reporting rules cannot drive applicability or comparison logic.
